basic_details.job_title: MSRLM Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Block Anchor, Senior CRP Posts
basic_details.short_information: UMED - Maharashtra State Rural Livelihoods Mission (Maharashtra Rajya Gramin Jeevanonnati Abhiyan), through Matrubhumi Mahila Prabhag Sangh, Patoda (Mav), Taluka Partur, District Jalna, is filling 2 contract posts, 1 IFC Block Anchor and 1 Senior CRP (Community Resource Person), for its Integrated Farming Cluster (IFC) development project. Applications must be handed in person at the Taluka Mission Management Unit (MSRLM) office, Panchayat Samiti Partur, on office days from 23 November 2026 to 1 December 2026, up to 04:00 PM. Applications received after this deadline will not be considered.

qualification.details: Qualification: minimum a degree in Agriculture or an agriculture-allied subject – Agricultural Technology, BSC Agriculture, BSC Horticulture, B.Tech Agriculture, BSC Fishery, BSC Forestry, BSC Veterinary, BSC Animal Husbandry, Bachelor of Business Administration. Experience: minimum 01 year. Computer knowledge is required. Post to be filled at Partur taluka level. | Qualification: minimum 12th pass. Must be working, or must have worked, under the MSRLM mission as Upjivika Sakhi, Udakrushi Sakhi, Pashu Sakhi, M-CRP (Krushi), Udyog Sakhi, Van Sakhi or ICRP. Experience: minimum 3 years. One post to be filled at each Prabhag Sangh level. | The notice gives no cut-off date for counting age and lists no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of each post.

important_instructions: The appointment is on an 11-month contract, till the project period. Applications are accepted only on office days; government holidays are excluded. Applications received after the prescribed deadline will not be considered.

rows.details: UMED - Maharashtra State Rural Livelihoods Mission, through Matrubhumi Mahila Prabhag Sangh, Patoda (Mav), Taluka Partur, District Jalna
IFC Block Anchor (Sevadata); Senior CRP (Community Resource Person)
Block Anchor Rs. 20,000/- per month; Senior CRP Rs. 6,000/- per month
Block Anchor: Agriculture or agriculture-allied degree; Senior CRP: 12th pass with MSRLM cadre experience
In person (offline) at Panchayat Samiti Partur

content_sections.heading: About MSRLM Partur
content_sections.text: UMED is the Maharashtra State Rural Livelihoods Mission. Under this mission, Matrubhumi Mahila Prabhag Sangh, Patoda (Mav), in Partur taluka of Jalna district, is implementing the Integrated Farming Cluster (IFC) development project. Both posts in this notice are for implementing that project, and the notice is signed by the President of the Prabhag Sangh.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted in person (by hand) at the Taluka Mission Management Unit (MSRLM) office, Panchayat Samiti Partur, on office days. The prescribed application form is available at the same office. Address for the form and for submission: Taluka Mission Management (MSRLM) UMED Office, Panchayat Samiti Partur, Dist. Jalna Application window: 23/11/2026 to 01/12/2026, up to 04:00 PM, excluding government holidays Contact numbers: 7499342384 / 9823545222 / 9665212999 The notice does not mention postal or email submission; it asks for the application to be presented in person.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Qualification: minimum a degree in Agriculture or an agriculture-allied subject – Agricultural Technology, BSC Agriculture, BSC Horticulture, B.Tech Agriculture, BSC Fishery, BSC Forestry, BSC Veterinary, BSC Animal Husbandry, Bachelor of Business Administration. Experience: minimum 01 year. Computer knowledge is required. Post to be filled at Partur taluka level. Qualification: minimum 12th pass. Must be working, or must have worked, under the MSRLM mission as Upjivika Sakhi, Udakrushi Sakhi, Pashu Sakhi, M-CRP (Krushi), Udyog Sakhi, Van Sakhi or ICRP. Experience: minimum 3 years. One post to be filled at each Prabhag Sangh level. The notice gives no cut-off date for counting age and lists no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment is on an 11-month contract, till the project period. Applications are accepted only on office days; government holidays are excluded. Applications received after the prescribed deadline will not be considered.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are in MSRLM Partur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Block Anchor post at Partur taluka level and 1 Senior CRP post at Prabhag Sangh level.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications are accepted from 23 November 2026 to 1 December 2026, up to 04:00 PM, excluding government holidays.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Block Anchor post?
faq.answer: A minimum degree in Agriculture or an agriculture-allied subject such as BSC Agriculture, BSC Horticulture, B.Tech Agriculture or Bachelor of Business Administration, with minimum 01 year experience and computer knowledge.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Senior CRP post?
faq.answer: Minimum 12th pass, with at least 3 years of experience working under MSRLM as Upjivika Sakhi, Udakrushi Sakhi, Pashu Sakhi, M-CRP (Krushi), Udyog Sakhi, Van Sakhi or ICRP.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 43 years for both the Block Anchor and Senior CRP posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The Block Anchor gets an honorarium of Rs. 20,000/- per month and the Senior CRP gets Rs. 6,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Collect the prescribed form from the Taluka Mission Management (MSRLM) UMED Office, Panchayat Samiti Partur, Dist. Jalna, and submit it there in person on an office day by 1 December 2026, 04:00 PM.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. Both posts are on an 11-month contract, till the project period of the Integrated Farming Cluster (IFC) development project.
